prompt: micronaut openapi multiple spec files UI frameworks support
answer:
Micronaut OpenAPI supports these UI frameworks:

| UI framework | Multiple OpenAPI spec files |
|---|---|
| Swagger UI | **Supported out of the box** |
| Scalar | **Supported out of the box** |
| RapiDoc | Not supported simultaneously; you must complete the template yourself |
| ReDoc | Not supported simultaneously; you must complete the template yourself |
| OpenAPI Explorer | Not supported simultaneously; you must complete the template yourself |

Micronaut can generate views for Swagger UI, ReDoc, OpenAPI Explorer, Scalar, and RapiDoc. It also supports RapiPdf for generating a PDF from a specification.
